info.name: ProcureX
info.description:
# API Collection Documentation

## Overview

This Postman collection contains the REST APIs developed for the **ProcureX** procurement management platform. It serves as a centralized workspace for testing, validating, and documenting backend services during development.

The collection is organized into logical modules based on business functionality, enabling developers and testers to efficiently interact with different microservices through a unified interface. Each request includes the necessary HTTP methods, headers, request bodies, authentication requirements, and expected responses wherever applicable.

## Purpose

The primary objectives of this Postman collection are to:

- Simplify API development and testing.
    
- Validate request and response workflows.
    
- Verify authentication and authorization mechanisms.
    
- Test business logic and data validation.
    
- Support integration between frontend and backend services.
    
- Provide reusable examples for developers and QA teams.
    

## Usage

1. Import the Postman collection into Postman.
    
2. Configure the required environment variables.
    
3. Start the necessary backend services.
    
4. Authenticate before accessing protected resources.

item.name: Admin
item.description:
## Admin

This folder contains all API endpoints related to **Admin-level operations** in the ProcureX procurement management platform. It covers the full lifecycle of admin activity — from initial setup and authentication to user management, vendor oversight, session control, and procurement catalog operations.

### What's included

- **Bootstrap & Authentication** — Admin registration, login, logout, password change, and token refresh.
- **User Management** — Create and manage internal roles such as Procurement Manager, Finance Manager, and Inventory Manager. List internal employees and update user account statuses.
- **Vendor Management** — List all vendors, view pending vendor registrations, and approve or reject vendor applications.
- **Categories** — Create, list, update, and delete (soft) product categories.
- **Products** — Create, list, get, update, and delete (soft) products. Delete also deactivates vendor-product mappings.
- **Vendor Records** — Create, list, get, update, activate, and suspend vendor records.
- **Vendor-Product Mappings** — Create and manage price/MOQ mappings between vendors and products.
- **Requisitions** — Create, list, retrieve, and update procurement requisitions.
- **RFQs** — Create, list, get, and close RFQs. Get RFQ by ID is also accessible to VENDOR.

### Usage

All requests in this folder are intended to be executed with admin-level credentials. Begin with the login request to obtain a valid access token, then use it in subsequent requests via the collection's authorization configuration.

item.name: Vendors
item.description:
## Vendors

This folder contains all API endpoints related to **Vendor operations** in the ProcureX procurement management platform. It covers the full lifecycle of a vendor's interaction with the platform — from self-registration and authentication to profile management, catalog access, and RFQ invitations.

### What's included

- **Registration & Authentication** — Vendor self-registration, login, logout, and token refresh.
- **Profile Management** — View own auth profile, change password, get own vendor catalog profile.
- **Account Management** — Vendor self-deletion.
- **Read-only Catalog Access** — List categories, list products, get product by ID, get vendor by ID, get requisition by ID.
- **Vendor-Product Mappings** — List own vendor-product mappings (prices and products supplied).
- **RFQs** — Get RFQ by ID, get own invitations.

### Usage

Vendors interact with the platform independently. Start with the self-registration request to create a vendor account, then log in to obtain an access token. Use the token for all subsequent authenticated requests.

item.name: Procurement Manager
item.description:
## Procurement Manager

This folder contains all API endpoints available to the **Procurement Manager** role in the ProcureX procurement management platform. It covers authentication, session management, and all procurement and vendor catalog operations for this role.

### What's included

- **Authentication** — Login and token refresh to establish and maintain an authenticated session.
- **Profile Management** — View own profile details and change password.
- **Session Control** — Logout to securely end the session.
- **Categories** — Create, list, and update product categories.
- **Products** — Create, list, get, and update products.
- **Vendors** — Create, list, get, update, activate, and suspend vendor records.
- **Vendor-Product Mappings** — Create and manage vendor-product price mappings. List by vendor and by product.
- **Requisitions** — Create, list, retrieve, and update procurement requisitions.
- **RFQs** — Create, list, get, and close RFQs.

### Usage

Use the login request to authenticate as a Procurement Manager and obtain an access token. The token is required for all subsequent requests. Follow the suggested test order: create a category, create a product, create and activate a vendor record, create a vendor-product mapping, create a requisition, then create an RFQ.
